flags.why: The word means effect or effectiveness, rather than general enjoyment or awesomeness ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ép_phê)).
The bubble-tea example uses ép phê as a general expression of enjoyment rather than an effect.
flags.fix: Thuốc này uống vào chẳng có ép phê gì, vẫn đau đầu. = This medicine has no effect; I still have a headache.

flags.why: This is a Vietnamese name for S derived from French, not the letter's English name ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ét-sì)).
The example discusses the word itself instead of using it to refer to petrol.
flags.fix: Chiếc xe đã hết ét-xăng. = The car has run out of petrol.

flags.why: This is a Vietnamese name for X derived from French, not the letter's English name ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ích-xì)).
Ô dù refers to influential protection or a protector, not a separate adjective meaning cliquish or given to cronyism ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ô_dù)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 2; its use refers to the protection described in sense 1.

flags.why: North Central Vietnam belongs to the Central dialect region, so treating it as both Northern and Central mislabels the distribution ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ô_dề)).
The widespread Internet sense 'over-the-top' is the meaning learners are most likely to encounter today ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ô_dề)).
The example defines the bird instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Một con ô tác đang kiếm ăn trên đồng cỏ. = A bustard is foraging on the grassland.

flags.why: The word means bus without a distinct minibus sense; nhỏ supplies the size distinction in the example ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=ô+tô+buýt)).
